Glossary

metricunitaggregationdefinitionnumeratordenominator
requests_expectedrequestsrunMeasured requests the profile asked for (warmup excluded).
requests_attemptedrequestsrunMeasured request attempts sent (retries count separately).
requests_succeededrequestsrunMeasured attempts that ended with a complete response.
requests_failedrequestsrunMeasured attempts that ended with an error (HTTP, stream or server error).
requests_timeoutrequestsrunMeasured attempts stopped at their deadline.
requests_cancelledrequestsrunMeasured attempts cancelled by the client.
requests_incompleterequestsrunMeasured attempts with no final status when the run ended (unresolved).
requests_with_first_tokenrequestsrunMeasured attempts that received at least one output token.
retriesrequestsrunAttempts that retry an earlier attempt (credited once if they succeed).
warmup_requestsrequestsrunWarmup requests (never part of any metric).
completion_ratefractionrunSucceeded / attempted measured requests.requests_succeededrequests_attempted
error_ratefractionrun(failed + timeout + cancelled + incomplete) / attempted measured requests.unsuccessful attemptsrequests_attempted
first_token_response_ratefractionrunAttempts with at least one output token / attempted. A first token is not a successful completion.requests_with_first_tokenrequests_attempted
output_length_mismatchesrequestsrunSucceeded requests whose output token count differs from the requested exact length (profiles that ignore EOS).
requests_exact_chunk_tokensrequestsrunSucceeded requests whose every streamed chunk carried an exact server-reported token count.
input_tokens_succeededtokensrunPrompt tokens of succeeded measured requests.
output_tokens_succeededtokensrunOutput tokens of succeeded measured requests (server usage count).
output_tokens_unsuccessfultokensrunOutput tokens streamed to measured requests that did not succeed (partial, failed, superseded). Never credited.
cohort_duration_ssrunFrom the start of main scheduling (warmup excluded) to the last measured completion or deadline. Drain included.
finite_cohort_output_tpstok/srunSuccessful cohort output tokens / cohort duration.output_tokens_succeededcohort_duration_s
finite_cohort_input_tpstok/srunSuccessful cohort input tokens / cohort duration.input_tokens_succeededcohort_duration_s
finite_cohort_total_tpstok/srunSuccessful cohort input + output tokens / cohort duration (same cohort).input + output tokens of succeeded requestscohort_duration_s
request_throughput_rpsreq/srunSucceeded measured requests / cohort duration.requests_succeededcohort_duration_s
output_tps_per_gputok/s/GPUrunDeployment output tok/s (finite cohort or steady successful) / all allocated physical GPUs, idle and prefill GPUs included.deployment output tok/sallocated physical GPUs
input_tps_per_gputok/s/GPUrunDeployment input tok/s / all allocated physical GPUs.deployment input tok/sallocated physical GPUs
total_tps_per_gputok/s/GPUrunDeployment total tok/s / all allocated physical GPUs.deployment total tok/sallocated physical GPUs
output_event_tps_max_10stok/s10 s windowDiagnostic: the largest output-token arrival rate in any 10 s window of the main phase (all requests). Not a headline.tokens arriving in the window10 s
steady_window_ssrunLength of the declared steady phase (ramp and drain excluded).
steady_output_event_tpstok/srunOutput tokens received inside the steady window (any request) / window seconds.tokens received in windowsteady_window_s
successful_steady_output_tpstok/srunIn-window output tokens of requests that eventually succeeded / window seconds (status known after drain).in-window tokens of succeeded requestssteady_window_s
steady_failed_request_tokenstokensrunIn-window output tokens of requests that did not succeed.
steady_unresolved_requestsrequestsrunRequests with in-window tokens whose final status was still unknown after drain.
steady_unresolved_tokenstokensrunIn-window tokens of unresolved requests (neither successful nor failed; never credited).
steady_completionsrequestsrunSucceeded requests whose terminal response arrived inside the window.
steady_request_rate_rpsreq/srunsteady_completions / window seconds.steady_completionssteady_window_s
steady_first_token_responsesrequestsrunRequests whose first output token arrived inside the window.
steady_boundary_started_beforerequestsrunRequests sent before the window that completed inside it.
steady_boundary_ended_afterrequestsrunRequests sent inside the window that completed after it.
steady_boundary_spanningrequestsrunRequests sent before the window and completed after it.
steady_cohort_requestsrequestsrunRequests SENT inside the window (cohort of the per-query medians).
offered_rate_rpsreq/srunDeclared Poisson arrival rate.
attempted_rate_rpsreq/srunRequests sent / arrival span.requests sentarrival span
achieved_completion_rpsreq/srunSucceeded requests / (arrival start to end of drain).requests_succeededarrival start to drain end
ttft_msmsrequestFirst content chunk arrival minus send. Succeeded measured requests.
e2e_terminal_msmsrequestTerminal response (stream end) minus send. Succeeded measured requests.
e2e_last_token_msmsrequestLast content chunk arrival minus send: the pinned InferenceX client's E2EL. Succeeded measured requests.
tpot_native_msmsrequestPinned InferenceX TPOT: (E2EL - TTFT) / (N - 1), N > 1, E2EL ending at the last content chunk. Its reciprocal is the client's 'interactivity'.
tpot_terminal_msmsrequest(terminal response latency - TTFT) / (N - 1), N > 1. Differs from the native TPOT by the stream's closing delay.
span_last_first_msmsrequest(last token - first token) / (N - 1), N > 1. Equal to the native TPOT by construction of the pinned client; named separately as the specification asks.
itl_token_msmstoken gapGaps between consecutive output tokens, from requests whose every chunk carried exactly one token (exact). Requests with multi-token chunks are excluded and counted.
chunk_gap_msmschunk gapGaps between consecutive content chunks (all succeeded requests): the pinned client's ITL. A multi-token chunk is ONE gap, never several zero gaps.
itl_estimated_uniform_msmstoken gap (estimate)ESTIMATE, only when multi-token chunks exist: each chunk gap divided evenly among its tokens.
client_queue_delay_msmsrequestSend minus scheduled time (client-side wait for a concurrency slot or a late arrival).
user_speed_post_first_token_tpstok/s/userrequest(N - 1) / (last token - first token), N > 1: generation speed one user sees after the first token.
user_speed_e2e_tpstok/s/userrequestN / (last token - send): speed one user sees including the wait for the first token.
interactivity_native_median_tpstok/s/userrun1000 / median native TPOT (ms): the pinned client's 'median_intvty'.1000median tpot_native_ms
slo_qualifying_requestsrequestsrunSucceeded measured requests that meet every request-level SLO condition together.
slo_qualifying_fractionfractionrunQualifying requests / attempted measured requests.slo_qualifying_requestsrequests_attempted
request_goodput_rpsreq/srunQualifying requests / the lane's duration (finite: cohort duration; steady: qualifying completions inside the window / window).qualifying requestsduration
output_goodput_tpstok/srunOutput tokens of qualifying requests / the lane's duration (steady: their in-window tokens / window).qualifying output tokensduration
output_goodput_tps_per_gputok/s/GPUrunoutput_goodput_tps / allocated physical GPUs.
server_running_requestsrequestsdecode log lineRunning requests in the server's decode batches during the main phase (the actual kernel batch, not client concurrency).
server_queue_depthrequestslog lineRequests waiting in the server queue during the main phase.
server_token_usagefractionlog lineKV token pool usage reported by the server.
server_retractionseventsrunDecode retractions (a request's state discarded and rebuilt by prefill) during the run.
server_cuda_graph_fractionfractiondecode log lineShare of decode log lines that ran a CUDA graph.
server_reported_gen_tpstok/sdecode log lineThe server's own generation throughput readings (diagnostic, not a headline).
gpu_memory_used_mibMiBsampleDevice memory in use (nvidia-smi), whole device, during the main phase.
gpu_memory_total_mibMiBrunDevice memory size.
gpu_power_wWsampleGPU board power (nvidia-smi power.draw), during the main phase. GPU only, not host or facility.
gpu_sm_clock_mhzMHzsampleSM clock during the main phase (thermal/clock telemetry).
gpu_temperature_cCsampleGPU temperature during the main phase.
gpu_energy_jJrunIntegral of GPU power over the measurement interval (trapezoid), only with adequate sample coverage.
gpu_energy_j_per_output_tokenJ/tokenrunGPU energy / successful output tokens of the same interval.gpu_energy_joutput_tokens_succeeded
gpu_energy_j_per_qualified_output_tokenJ/tokenrunGPU energy / output tokens of SLO-qualifying requests.gpu_energy_jqualifying output tokens
usd_per_hourUSD/hrunDeployment cost per hour from pricing.json under its cost mode (null when no price is recorded).
usd_per_million_output_tokensUSD/1M tokrunUSD/h x 1e6 / (3600 x successful deployment output tok/s).USD/h x 1e63600 x output tok/s
usd_per_million_qualified_output_tokensUSD/1M tokrunSame with SLO-qualified output tok/s.USD/h x 1e63600 x output_goodput_tps
usd_per_million_input_tokensUSD/1M tokrunAlternative view: the WHOLE deployment cost attributed to input tokens. Not additive with the output view.USD/h x 1e63600 x input tok/s
usd_per_million_total_tokensUSD/1M tokrunAlternative view: the whole deployment cost attributed to input + output tokens. Never an output-token cost.USD/h x 1e63600 x total tok/s

Exports: runs.csv / runs.json (every metric of every run), summary.csv / summary.json, claims.json, unmeasured.csv, glossary.json, sources.json, displayed_values.json (checked by python -m lqh check), figures/, MANIFEST.sha256. Nothing here has been submitted or published.
